school_name: Citadel Military College of South Carolina
title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the functional study hubs, recreational retreats, and quiet corners that Citadel cadets and students use to navigate their daily military and academic schedules.

cards.title: Collaborative Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Daniel Library
cards.notes: Reserve one of the four collaborative study rooms for group projects or quiet focus. Check in at the Information Desk to access your booked space.
cards.short_summary: Private group study rooms available for reservation within the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: Daniel Library facilities include four collaborative study rooms and the Prioleau Reading Room for student use.
cards.access_notes: Rooms must be vacated before library closing; current library card or ID required for reservation.

cards.title: Kerr Reading Room
cards.subtitle: 261 Bond Hall
cards.notes: Visit this quiet study space featuring a large projection screen for presentations and three private study rooms equipped with monitors.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet study and group meeting area located on the second floor of Bond Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kerr Reading Room in 261 Bond Hall provides students with quiet study space and private rooms with 32-inch monitors.
cards.source_title: Student Resources - Master of Business Administration
cards.access_notes: Open every school day; primarily serves business students but offers a central workstation for presentations.

cards.title: Class of 1981 Pavilion
cards.subtitle: Waterfront at Ashley River
cards.notes: Relax by the gas log fireplace or use the charcoal grills at this waterfront pavilion. It is a shared recreational space for the entire community.
cards.short_summary: A waterfront recreational pavilion featuring a fireplace and grills for student and faculty use.
cards.evidence_claim: The Class of 1981 Pavilion at the Swain Boating Center features a gas log fireplace, picnic tables, and charcoal grills.
cards.source_title: Hours of Operation - Swain Boating Center
cards.access_notes: Normal operating hours are 0800-2000 daily; users are responsible for cleanup of grills.

cards.title: Recreational Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Deas Hall
cards.notes: Access the 25-meter pool, racquetball courts, and strength training facilities. Remember to wear appropriate gym attire and bring your ID.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus hub for intramural sports, swimming, and individual weight training.
cards.evidence_claim: Deas Hall houses an eight-lane swimming pool, six racquetball courts, and a 14,500-square-foot gymnasium.
cards.source_title: Deas Hall Membership - Intramural, Club and Recreational Athletics
cards.access_notes: Priority use for students and ROTC; membership card required for entry.

cards.title: Munnerlyn Food Court
cards.subtitle: Student Activities Building
cards.notes: Grab a quick meal at this full-service snack bar. It serves as a central social hub for cadets between classes and training.
cards.short_summary: A central campus dining and social area located within the student activities building.
cards.evidence_claim: Mark Clark Hall houses the Munnerlyn Food Court, a full-service snack bar open to the public and students.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; houses the campus bookstore and student services.

cards.title: Mathematics Lab
cards.subtitle: Student Success Center
cards.notes: Drop in for academic coaching or use the specialized math and computer labs. It is the go-to spot for supplemental instruction.
cards.short_summary: An academic support hub providing tutoring and specialized computer labs for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Thompson Hall is home to the Student Success Center, which includes a Mathematics Lab and several computer labs.
cards.access_notes: Located in Room 117; appointments can be made via email or phone.

cards.title: Gothic Sanctuary
cards.subtitle: Avenue of Remembrance
cards.notes: Find a moment of quiet reflection among the 14th-century Gothic architecture and handcrafted wrought iron fixtures.
cards.short_summary: A non-denominational chapel used for religious services, weddings, and quiet meditation.
cards.evidence_claim: Summerall Chapel is a cruciform, non-denominational chapel that supports students through religious expression and counseling.
cards.access_notes: Open for weekly worship services and special events; accessible to the broader community.

cards.title: Bastin Financial Lab
cards.subtitle: Baker School of Business
cards.notes: Experience a simulated trading floor with dual-monitor terminals and a 22-foot color ticker display. Ideal for finance students.
cards.short_summary: A state-of-the-art financial simulation lab with real-world data and analytical tools.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bastin Financial Lab features 29 computer terminals, a full-color ticker display, and a 92-inch LED market video wall.
cards.source_title: Student Resources - Master of Business Administration
cards.access_notes: Used extensively by the Financial Management Association; check for lab availability.

cards.title: McKissick Library
cards.subtitle: Hagood Avenue
cards.notes: Utilize this quiet library space located just off the main campus. It is a useful alternative for study when the main library is busy.
cards.short_summary: A secondary library and visitor center located within the alumni complex.
cards.evidence_claim: The Holliday Alumni Center houses the McKissick Library, a grand foyer, and visitor center.
cards.source_title: The John Monroe Johnson Holliday Alumni Center
cards.access_notes: Located across from the football stadium; serves as a staging area for visitors and alumni.

cards.title: Bulldog Student Section
cards.subtitle: Sansom Field
cards.notes: Join the Corps of Cadets in the stands for home football games. Experience the electric atmosphere of Southern Conference matchups.
cards.short_summary: The home field for Citadel football, featuring a dedicated section for the Corps of Cadets.
cards.evidence_claim: Johnson Hagood Stadium is the home of Citadel football, where the student section and alumni bring energy to every game.
cards.access_notes: Cadet attendance is often mandatory for home games; public tickets require purchase.
